overall_summary: The channel shows clear high-performance outliers in the 'रिश्ते' (relationships/husband-wife) category, specifically focusing on married life dynamics. Other topics like family love and raw shayari underperformed significantly.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1766 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1674 views) significantly outperformed all other categories.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on domestic relationship dynamics and marital emotional struggles.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 15 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid heavy, abstract poetic wording; focus instead on grounded everyday observations.
